scope: Read-only analysis of an independently launched, unregistered 511-item probe. This artifact does not approve, register, or validate that probe as a canonical experiment.
bounded_interpretation: The fulltrack checkpoint-family PQ gap persists when both models receive the same neutral caption, while q9 adds a smaller positive shift inside the fulltrack family. This makes a prompt-specific evaluation-alignment error less likely and motivates a full 5521 paired checkpoint-family/Q matrix. It does not identify a training-data cause, validate the unregistered probe, or establish a causal fulltrack advantage.
limitations: The probe was not preregistered, had no HARN or queue ownership, used only 511 paired rows, and ran concurrently with an authorized training job.
The TSV was a prefix subset rather than a preregistered random sample.
The literal CFG spelling was 0.0 rather than the canonical metadata spelling 0.
CLAP was not computed, per-audio hashes were not frozen, and generated audio remains under an ephemeral /tmp path.
Checkpoint-family contrasts confound caption corpus, training trajectory, and Q-training history.
